task.title: Archive an active profile
task.shortdesc: Move an active profile out of the normal active list without permanently deleting it.

prereq.p: The profile is active, visible in the Library, and no longer needed for normal editing or export workflows.

context.p: Archiving is reversible. It keeps the profile available through archived or all lifecycle filters.

step.cmd: Confirm the row name, schema, validation state, and updated time.

info.p: Expected result: you know exactly which profile will change lifecycle state.

info.note: Archived profiles are retained but no longer behave like normal active export targets.

step.cmd: Wait for the action status and refresh the Library if needed.

info.p: The row appears under archived or all lifecycle filters after the action completes.

result.p: The profile is archived and can be restored later.

postreq.p: Recovery: restore the profile if you archived the wrong row.
